items.title: Halloween 2026 in VR: Every Event, Update and Launch With a Date on It
items.summary: Phasmophobia's Crimson Eye runs to November 1, VRChat's Spookality winners go on show October 16, a VR horror game jam closes October 22 and Steam Scream V…
items.content:
Phasmophobia's Halloween event started yesterday and runs to November 1. VRChat 's horror showcase opens a week from today, Valve's Halloween sale has a start date, and Meta's does not.

Nearly all of October's VR calendar is already public, scattered across patch notes, store update feeds, a contest rules page and one Steamworks table. Here it is in date order. Every entry was checked on October 9 at the developer's or the platform's own page, and the one date that comes from somewhere else says so.

Since October 2: Gorilla Tag. Another Axiom's Halloween update put the decorations back up, added a cosmetic set called Bare Bones and brought back Ghost Tag. The post gives no end date. Gorilla Tag is free on Quest and Steam .

October 8 to November 1: Phasmophobia, Crimson Eye. Kinetic Games' event post names eight locations that turn red under the Blood Moon: 6 Tanglewood Drive, 42 Edgefield Road, 13 Willow Street, Grafton Farmhouse, Bleasdale Farmhouse, Camp Woodwind, Nell's Diner and the standard version of Point Hope. Play an investigation on any of them and you earn event points. You also hunt for Blood Moon totems, and the event weather makes the ghosts harder. Points unlock a seasonal tee, an ID card and badge set, a charm, and a trophy that upgrades as you go. Would you rather skip all of it? Wednesday's patch added a toggle that turns the event maps off for your session.

Phasmophobia plays flat or in VR on Steam and on PS5 with a PS VR2 . There is no Quest version. On a Steam Frame , Valve's rating is still Unsupported for standalone play , from a test dated July 22, before Kinetic replaced the VR character rig in August.

October 8: two launches. Shil , a surreal first-person puzzle game with enemies you cannot see, arrived on Quest at $14.99. And Into the Radius 2 reached PS VR2 at $39.99, on the date CM Immersive moved it to after a certification delay.

Tuesday, October 13: Real VR Fishing. Not horror at all. Devs United Games says its October update brings five Halloween maps, three of them new, with one new fish for each. The Zombie Shark and Haunted Goblin Shark return from earlier years. Five pumpkin costumes, two rod sets and a title are earned by playing, "no purchase required." The same update adds hand tracking with a built-in tutorial. It also adds an early ice fishing mode for mixed reality, the view where you see your real room through the headset's cameras, and in that mode your own floor turns into ice. The post sits on the game's Quest listing, and UploadVR reports the same day for Steam .

Thursday, October 15: two Phasmophobia deadlines. A Twitch Drop is a reward you get in a game for watching streams of it. Phasmophobia's hands you the Crimson Eye tee for two hours of viewing, and it ends at 11:59 PM BST, which is 3:59 PM Pacific. The same day, Double XP and Rewards switches on and stays on until October 22.

Friday, October 16: Spookality goes on show. Spookality is VRChat's yearly Halloween jam, a contest where creators build worlds and avatars to a theme before a deadline. This year the theme is Camp Whispering Screams, which VRChat's announcement describes as "a tribute to 80s-style horror." Entries closed on October 1 and judging runs through the 15th. From October 16 to November 2, the twelve winning worlds are featured in a Spookality World Row inside the app, and the twelve winning avatars get a public row of their own.

Quest owners get the whole set. The official rules say worlds "MUST be cross-platform (PC, Android, and iOS)." A standalone Quest runs the Android version of VRChat, so every winning world should load on the headset with no PC involved. VRChat is free on Quest and Steam .

Thursday, October 22: a jam deadline. The VR IS DEAD Halloween Jam on itch.io gives developers three weeks to build a VR horror game. Fifty-seven had signed up as of October 9. Submissions close at 11:59 PM Pacific on the 22nd, and entrants then play and rate each other's games until noon Pacific on October 29. The prize for the top three teams is a title on the host's Discord server. No cash. The host, who runs the Fist Full of Shrimp YouTube channel, calls it "a laid back and fun jam meant to help beef up your development skills while helping others."

What you get out of it is a page of free, short, strange VR horror games, all of them in by the 22nd. The host's FAQ advises entrants to aim for as many headsets as possible and to consider both a PC build and an Android build. A PC build runs through SteamVR like any other game. An Android build comes as an APK, the file format a Quest installs apps from, and installing one from outside the store is called sideloading: you turn on developer mode for the headset in Meta's phone app, plug it into a computer and send the file across with a tool such as SideQuest . These are three-week builds from hobbyists, so expect rough edges, and download only from an entry's own itch.io page.

Monday, October 26: Steam Scream V, and a charity week. Valve's Steamworks event schedule lists Steam Scream V, this year's Halloween fest, from October 26 to November 2. The table gives dates and nothing about prices. It will be the first Scream with a Steam Frame out, and the list of horror games certified to run on the headset by itself is short. Over in Phasmophobia, the last week of Crimson Eye doubles as Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts, a fundraiser with the American Heart Association. Kinetic says the community raised over $100,000 last year.

Thursday, October 29: Dark Trip. Dark Trip is a gothic horror escape room from iWorlds, dated October 29 on Steam, and its store page says you can play it flat or in VR. A free demo went up on October 8 if you want to try it before then. The jam's rating period ends at noon Pacific the same day.

items.title: Phasmophobia Hits 30 Million Sales as Crimson Eye Returns
items.summary: Phasmophobia surpasses 30 million sales as Kinetic Games launches Crimson Eye 2026 with Blood Moon hunts, seasonal rewards and 1.0 plans.
items.content:
Phasmophobia has surpassed 30 million sales worldwide, marking a major milestone for Kinetic Games as the annual Crimson Eye Halloween event returns with blood moon hunts, seasonal rewards and new challenges.

The co-op horror game, which began life as a solo project before entering Early Access in 2020, has now become a global horror phenomenon across PC and console. The latest milestone comes as Kinetic Games continues to expand the game ahead of its planned 1.0 release in the second half of 2027.

Running until November 1 , Crimson Eye gives ghost hunters the chance to take on rotating event maps featuring guaranteed Blood Moon weather. The dangerous conditions make hunts even more difficult, with ghosts moving faster and player sanity draining more quickly, although successful investigations come with increased rewards.

The event maps include Tanglewood Drive , Camp Woodwind , Grafton Farmhouse , Bleasdale Farmhouse , Point Hope , Edgefield Road , Nell’s Diner and Willow Street . Point Hope is available as a Standard map only, with its Restricted version excluded from the event.

Players can work towards a range of Crimson Eye rewards through both community and personal goals. Community rewards include the Beholder ID Card and Badge and the Blood Moon Trophy .

Personal goals include the Blood Moon Charm , a seasonal event T-shirt and upgrades to the Crimson Eye trophy. Players who have already unlocked the trophy will instead earn points towards their existing trophy.

Twitch Drops are also returning, with players able to unlock a Crimson Eye T-shirt cosmetic by watching two hours of Phasmophobia streams between October 8 and October 15, 2026 .

A Double XP and Rewards event will then run from October 15 to October 22 , giving investigators boosted rewards for completed investigations.

The Crimson Eye event has now been running for three years, with the Blood Moon first introduced to Phasmophobia in 2024. This year’s event arrives alongside the game’s 30 million sales milestone.

Since its Early Access debut, Kinetic Games has continued to expand the game with new haunted locations, additional ghost types, improved player characters and a range of quality-of-life changes shaped by community feedback.

Two major Quality of Life updates released this year brought significant improvements to player characters, customisation and evidence collection, while also introducing additional Restricted maps for faster-paced ghost hunts.

Daniel Knight , CEO of Kinetic Games and Game Director for Phasmophobia, said the original goal when developing the game was to sell 1,000 units during its first year. Reaching 30 million sales has therefore far exceeded those initial expectations, with Knight thanking both players and the team that helped grow the game.

The final week of Crimson Eye will once again support the American Heart Association through Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts , returning from October 26 to November 1 .

The Phasmophobia community raised more than $100,000 for the American Heart Association last year, and the charity event is returning for the final week of this year’s Halloween celebrations.

items.title: Phasmophobia ‘Crimson Eye’ Update Begins Rolling Out
items.summary: As is tradition, Kinetic Games has been rolling out its annual Halloween update, seeing the return of totems and increasing challenges.
items.content:
Every year, Kinetic Games rolls out a special Halloween update for its hit ghost hunting title Phasmophobia . This year is, of course, no exception, as the “Crimson Eye” event has started rolling out. As always, it’s replete with new challenges and everything is bathed in an eerie glow (this time red).

The update technically began on October 7, implementing some preparations , including a couple of small fixes, but now the main event is upon us. Veterans of the game will already be familiar, seeing the return of temporary changes to some of the maps, including Nell’s Diner.

In this version of Crimson Eye, players will be tasked with “hunting down Blood Moon totems and completing investigations and optional objectives to earn points.” Naturally, you’ll also have to complete tasks while “under the threat of Blood Moon weather,” which makes things that much more difficult.

There are a couple of Phasmophobia -specific goodies, including the traditional Double XP & Rewards scheme. This will take place between October 15 and October 22. You can also earn a seasonal event T-shirt and Beholder ID Card & Badge set for your character.

The recent update also came with a new feature: a Seasonal Event toggle. As the name implies, this allows players to turn on/off events (including future ones) if they don’t wish to play them.

items.title: PHASMOPHOBIA LAUNCHES SEASONAL CRIMSON EYE EVENT AS GAME HITS 30 MILLION SALES
items.summary: It’s all treats and no tricks as the genre-defining co-op horror title hits a major milestone alongside the return of its annual Halloween eventSOUTHAMPTON,...
items.content:
Press release — 8 October 2026 12:27 Share Share this story Copy link Link copied! Download

It’s all treats and no tricks as the genre-defining co-op horror title hits a major milestone alongside the return of its annual Halloween event

SOUTHAMPTON, UK – October 8th, 2026 – Today, Kinetic Games announces that Phasmophobia has surpassed 30 million sales since its Early Access release across PC and console as its annual in-game Halloween event, Crimson Eye, launches for another year of terrifying hunts and seasonal rewards.

Since launching into Early Access in 2020, Phasmophobia has grown from a solo project into a global horror phenomenon, with Kinetic Games continuing to expand and evolve the game with new content and seasonal events. Until November 1st, Crimson Eye brings ghost hunters spectral rewards, spooktacular frights and bone-chilling challenges, with rotating event maps featuring blood moon weather for even more terrifying hunts. Ghosts have increased speed and sanity drains quicker, but brave players can earn higher rewards in return.

The fan-favourite fright has now been running for three years, with the blood moon first appearing in Phasmophobia in 2024. Crimson Eye returns this year as the team celebrates another major milestone: 30 million sales worldwide.

Starting as a solo project, Phasmophobia has grown into a global co-op horror phenomenon across PC and console. Throughout the game’s journey in Early Access, the Kinetic Games team has worked to expand haunted locations, introduce new ghost types and improve player character models, all shaped closely by community feedback.

This year alone, two major Quality of Life updates brought vast improvements to player characters, customisation and evidence collection, while introducing further Restricted maps for fast-paced ghost-hunting.

“So much has changed since I started making Phasmophobia on my own at my parents' house,” commented Daniel Knight, CEO of Kinetic Games and Game Director for Phasmophobia. “My initial goal was to sell 1000 units in the first year, so it’s hard to believe we’re celebrating 30 million. I’m so grateful to everyone who has played, and to the team who have worked alongside me on it. There is plenty more to come as we head towards 1.0.”

Phasmophobia’s success has also enabled Kinetic Games to expand its ambitions beyond the game itself, with the studio launching Kinetic Publishing earlier this year to champion independent development teams. Drawing on Daniel Knight’s journey from solo developer to global success, the publishing division gives indie devs the support and resources to make incredible games without compromising their creative vision. The first Kinetic Publishing Showcase in August revealed its first slate of titles, with its first game, starship job simulator Contact Protocol , launching in Spring 2027.

Looking ahead, the Kinetic Games team is gearing up for Phasmophobia’s highly anticipated 1.0 release, slated for the second half of 2027. Beginning next year, the studio will share spooky sneak peeks into the update’s development, including major overhauls to ghost design and overall gameplay.

The Crimson Eye event is available now in Phasmophobia, including:

Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with the American Heart Association

Phasmophobia is available in Early Access on Steam , PS5 , PS VR2 , and Xbox Series X|S , priced at $19.99/£16.75/€19.50.

Assets for this announcement can be found here . For more information on the Crimson Eye event, please see the blog post here .

items.title: Phasmophobia Halloween Event and Rewards Officially Revealed
items.content:
Phasmophobia Halloween Event and Rewards Officially Revealed From GameRant (Written by Joshua Duckworth) on October 7, 2026 | OpenCritic

Halloween has become an iconic part of the year for the best horror games , giving developers an excuse to bring players back for seasonal events, limited-time challenges, and new ways to make already-scary games even more unsettling. Few games are better suited to the holiday than Phasmophobia , which has spent years turning ghost hunting into a multiplayer experience where even familiar locations can become dangerously fun when the lights go out.

Phasmophobia has also made seasonal events a regular part of its yearly schedule, giving players another reason to return as October rolls around. The game's Halloween celebrations have become especially recognizable, often changing familiar locations and adding special objectives that give investigations a different feel. Phasmophobia is keeping that tradition going again in 2026, with Kinetic Games now laying out exactly what players can expect throughout October.

Following the launch of the buggy Player Character Update, Phasmophobia releases a patch and promises more improvements are coming to the game.

Phasmophobia's Crimson Eye 2026 event will officially begin on October 8 and run through November 1. Kinetic Games says the update containing the event will deploy on October 7, one day before the event itself begins. Crimson Eye...

Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We have an update for you.

Today’s small update is in preparation for Crimson Eye, launching 8th October 2026, with the focus on getting the game ready for the start of the event. Our next major update, our move to Unity 6 is scheduled for November and will feature a host of bug fixes and improvements, all of which we’ll detail in an upcoming Development Preview.

items.content:
Once more, Ghost Hunters, we pay homage to the Blood Moon. Our dear Crimson Eye.

Today, we’re excited to reveal that this year’s Crimson Eye event will begin on October 8th, 2026, and run until November 1st, 2026. An update containing the event will be deployed on October 6th.

As with previous years’ events, the Crimson Eye will cast its presence across several locations in Phasmophobia. Playing on these locations will grant each player event points, working towards unlocking the Community and Personal rewards, details of which are below.

The following list of locations will be featured throughout the event:

  • 6 Tanglewood Drive

    [/*]

  • 42 Edgefield Road

    [/*]

  • Grafton Farmhouse

    [/*]

  • 13 Willow Street

    [/*]

  • Bleasdale Farmhouse

    [/*]

  • Point Hope (Standard only, Point Hope Restricted will not be included)

    [/*]

  • Camp Woodwind

    [/*]

  • Nell’s Diner

    [/*]

For those of you who have taken part in previous Crimson Eye events, you’ll know what to expect, but you’ll also get to see how Nell’s Diner and the reworked 6 Tanglewood Drive & 13 Willow Street look dressed in red. For newer Ghost Hunters, you’ll be tasked with hunting down Blood Moon totems and completing investigations and optional objectives to earn points, all while under the threat of Blood Moon weather, increasing the challenge you’ll face from ghosts.

Players will have several different unlockable rewards during the event: a seasonal event tee, the Beholder ID Card & Badge set and the Blood Moon charm.

Alongside these will be the upgradeable trophy. If you have previously unlocked this, you’ll continue to earn points and upgrades to your existing Trophy, rather than a new one.

During the event, we have a few different plans in place, so please do read on to learn what’s in store throughout October.

Twitch Drop

During the first week of Crimson Eye, a Twitch Drop campaign will be running for all Phasmophobia streamers. After watching a total of two hours of Phasmophobia streams, you’ll earn the Crimson Eye tee. The campaign will be live from the moment the event begins until 11:59 PM BST on October 15th, 2026.

Double XP & Rewards

As is becoming tradition with Phasmophobia’s seasonal events, we’ll be running a Double XP & Rewards event during Crimson Eye. This will be taking place between October 15th–22nd, with all rewards from completed investigations being doubled during this period. Mark your calendars, Ghost Hunters!

Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with the American Heart Association

Finally, during the final week of Crimson Eye (October 26th–November 1st), we’ll be bringing back Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with our friends over at the American Heart Association! Last year, the Phasmophobia community raised over $100,000, which was an incredible achievement and went a long way towards helping the AHA team with their important work.

This year, we’re planning to go bigger and better; this event, and its rewards, will be accessible to all Phasmophobia creators & players when it goes live. While we’ll share details nearer the time, we just wanted to get the dates in your calendars!

We look forward to celebrating our favourite season with you once again, Ghost Hunters.

items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We’ve got an update for you.

Today, we have released an update for Phasmophobia to address several issues that were raised following our latest Quality of Life update. Thank you to everyone who has helped with information and feedback to help us identify and fix these bugs.

Our next update following this will be our transition to Unity 6. This will be releasing in November, which is just a little shift from our original aim of October. We’ll be talking in more detail about this update as well as our cosmetics update in an upcoming Development Preview. Rest assured, our Crimson Eye event is still scheduled for October. More on that at a later date too.

Full patch notes for today’s release can be found below:

items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

Today we have released Phasmophobia v0.19.0.0, our latest update that brings with it the second part of our Quality of Life update. Full patch notes can be found below, and in-depth details on what’s new can be found in this blog.

New

  • Added new Restricted variants of the below maps.

    [/*]

  • Prison

    • Brownstone High School

      [/*]

    • Point Hope

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Video Cameras, Photo Cameras and Sound Recorders will now indicate Duplicate evidence.

    [/*]

  • Tier 1 Photo Cameras will display a yellow LED light.

    • Tier 2 & 3 Photo Cameras and all Tiers of Video Cameras will display faded text rather than the usual bold white text.

      [/*]

    • Tier 1 Sound Recorder will lower the brightness of the Volume indicators.

      [/*]

      [/*]
    [/*]

    [/*]

Changes

items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

Thank you to everyone for the warm reception to our first Quality of Life update last month, and we’re glad to see many of you enjoying Phasmophobia once more.

Today as promised, we’re sharing details on the upcoming second Quality of Life update for Phasmophobia. We’ll be releasing this update across all platforms on 25th August, 2026. Exact release times are still to be confirmed, so keep an eye on our channels for official confirmation of when the update is live. 

Let’s break down a couple of the features we’re excited about before sharing the full list: 

New Restricted Options

For a long while, we have seen folks requesting smaller versions of our larger maps in the vein of Sunny Meadows Restricted. With this update we’re excited to introduce Restricted versions for Prison, Brownstone High School and Point Hope.

As with Sunny Meadows, these map variants are designed for quicker games in locations that we know players enjoy but sometimes don’t want to be investigating the larger area. In the case of Point Hope Restricted, which will be classed as small, Ghost Hunters will be able to access up to the Dining Room while Prison and Brownstone High School will have multiple variants - classed as Small and Medium respectively - which will be randomly assigned upon loading into a contract. 

Brownstone High School in particular will have a total of 4 map variants following the update. With such a big map, we believed it was appropriate to give a variety of variations, giving Ghost Hunters a sense of mystery when loading up. Outside each Restricted version of the map, a small piece of environmental decor will signify which variant of the map you’re on.

Journal & Evidence Changes

We made a handful of changes and improvements to Evidence collection with the first Quality of Life update, and we’re doing the same with the second. As with all of our updates, we’ll be looking for and reading through player feedback on these changes so please do let us know your thoughts once you’ve spent some time with them. 

Since our Chronicle update last year, we’ve been working on finessing the Unique/Duplicate system. A change we’re introducing with this next update means there’ll now be visual indicators to show that a piece of Media a Ghost Hunter captures is a Duplicate without the need to check the Journal. 

To detect a Duplicate, keep an eye out for the following indicators:

  • Tier 1 Photo Cameras will display a yellow LED light.

    [/*]

  • Tier 2 & 3 Photo Cameras and all Tiers of Video Cameras will display a faded overlay, rather than the usual bold white text.

    [/*]

  • Tier 1 Sound Recorder will lower the brightness of the Volume indicators.

    [/*]

  • Tier 2 & 3 Sound Recorders will display faded sound waves.

    [/*]

Another important addition in this update is being able to see other Ghost Hunters’ Evidence and Ghost selections in the Journal. This means there’ll be no more need to double check with other players which pieces of Evidence you’ve captured and see other’s opinions on which Ghost the group is dealing with - and of course making sure everyone has the same selection when you’re leaving in the Truck!

Elsewhere, we’ve replaced the Keys section in the journal with the ‘Items We’ve Found’ section. Appearing in the order they are found, this will display collected items such as keys, the bone and seasonal event collectables. On this same page, a gender symbol (♀/♂) will now be displayed alongside the Ghost's name, allowing for easier understanding of male and female names and Ghost types - especially for non-English speaking players.

VR Improvements

With this Quality of Life update, we’re completely replacing the VR character rig across all platforms. This means more responsive movement in-line with your own body’s, improved accuracy on the character model to match player’s arm length as well as an overall improvement to visuals of the character model when playing with VR users.

We’re also addressing several regularly reported issues from VR players, which we’ll detail in the full patch notes at release. As with other areas of Phasmophobia, please do let us know any feedback you have from your time in VR or any issues you encounter via our Help Centre.

Gameplay Improvements

Finally, for today, we just wanted to dive in to some of the changes coming to the gameplay of Phasmophobia. Firstly, we’ll be implementing the ability to select the Ghost Type for any Custom Difficulty investigations. You’ll find this in the Ghost settings when setting up your game, as you can see in the screenshot below.

Another change with this update is a change to character appearance upon death. As seen below, the dead body will now be seen with a greyer skin as well as misty eyes. Dead players will also appear this way to others while Dead. In addition to this change a player’s voice chat will now be cut off as soon as they die - the moment their neck is snapped during the death animation.

Below, you’ll find a list of all the New features coming with this Quality of Life update as well as the Changes section. At the release of the update, as mentioned, we’ll share the full patch notes along with the list of Fixes for known bugs and issues. We look forward to sharing this update with you on August 25th, 2026.

items.title: Phasmophobia: The Board Game Deluxe Edition Returns for a Limited Time
items.summary: Lost In Cult and Kinetic Games have reopened limited pre-orders for the Phasmophobia: The Board Game Deluxe Edition ahead of its expected Q4 2026 release.
items.content:
Lost In Cult and Kinetic Games have reopened limited pre-orders for the collector’s edition after the original run sold out shortly after it launched in October 2025.

Based on Kinetic Games’ hit cooperative horror game, Phasmophobia: The Board Game brings the ghost-hunting experience to the tabletop for one to four players. Investigators will search haunted locations, gather evidence, identify one of 24 different ghost types, and try to keep their sanity intact as increasingly unsettling paranormal events unfold.

The standard game includes investigator cards, themed dice, a Ghost Behaviour Board, more than 50 Hallucination cards, and everything needed to recreate the tense cooperative gameplay that made the video game a phenomenon.

Collectors looking for something extra may want to move quickly. The Deluxe Edition once again includes several exclusive items, including a digitally signed edition from the Kinetic Games team, a behind-the-scenes hardcover book, a secret film strip, Polaroid memorabilia, and a premium presentation box. It also features glow-in-the-dark components, metallic tarot cards, upgraded dice, and other cosmetic enhancements designed specifically for dedicated fans.

Lost In Cult says production on the board game continues, with the first shipments currently expected during the fourth quarter of 2026.

Given how quickly the Deluxe Edition disappeared during its initial release, interested players may not want to wait too long before securing a copy this time around.

Preorder a copy here https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/phas-std-sy5y5
